message: Generated from Stimulation_2emg.hex Debug build on 2026-07-04. Firmware initializes two SAADC routes together: ADC2/AIN2 for PPG and ADC3/AIN3 for raw noise. PPG modes stream selected LED-on raw ADC code with G/I/R tags and also stream ADC3 raw samples. Firmware no longer emits BIT frames; the Web GUI toggles browser-side ADC3 bit extraction and selects residual VN, delta VN, or LSB before XOR-encrypting 14-bit PPG samples.
